# Advertaro Creative Studio

> Advertaro (Private) Limited is an award-winning creative technology and web development studio based in Colombo, Sri Lanka. Specializing in high-performance web applications, interactive 3D/WebGL experiences, UI/UX design systems, and brand strategy.

## Overview
- Company Name: Advertaro Creative Studio
- Legal Name: Advertaro (Private) Limited / Advertaro (Pvt) Ltd
- Head Office: Colombo / Mount Lavinia, Western Province, Sri Lanka
- Primary Domain: https://advertaro.lk
- General Inquiries: hello@advertaro.lk
- Phone: +94 71 688 0657
- Consultation & Scheduling: https://cal.com/advertaro/30min

## Industry Recognition & Awards
Advertaro is officially recognized by BestWeb.LK, the premier national web awards organized by the LK Domain Registry:
- 2023: Silver Winner — "Best Web Developer" (Special Award Category)
- 2022: Bronze Winner — "Best Web Developer" (Special Award Category)
- Multiple Years: Multiple websites conceptualized, designed, and developed by Advertaro have won Best Website Gold Awards and overall category honors.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- Web Development & Engineering: Bespoke web applications built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and WebGL/Three.js shaders.
- UI/UX & Digital Product Design: Custom design systems, fluid motion design, responsive multi-device experiences, accessible user journeys.
- Digital Branding & Creative Direction: Visual identity systems, typography direction, and modern brand narrative for digital-first enterprises.
